subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB219
title: Modifies the general powers of the Public Utility Commission by removing the commission's general power to balance the interests of the utility investor and the consumer in establishing fair and reasonable rates.
headline: SB 219 did not pass

claims.text: SB 219 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 219 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
